documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue growing 27% and EBITDA growing 55% year-on-year. The company's construction equipment segment showed robust growth, while the large agricultural equipment segment remained subdued but is expected to hit a cyclical bottom in calendar year 2026. Management highlighted that Mexico operations are on track for first deliveries in Q3 of this year, and the company continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities with a net cash position of INR 190 crores. Uniparts India reported total income of INR 3,552 Mn for Q1 FY27, representing a 27.2% year-on-year growth, alongside EBITDA growth of 55.3% to INR 898 Mn and PAT growth of 64.3% to INR 566 Mn. Management highlighted that Q1 performance was aligned with quarter-on-quarter guidance and better than annual guidance.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 growth on a year-on-year basis.
guidance.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company expects Q2 FY27 to be robust and in line with Q1.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: The company expects to comfortably deliver over 20% plus EBITDA margin in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin, right?

guidance.claim: The company expects Mexico revenue to be in the mid-single-digit million dollar level for FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: The company expects warehousing sales to remain in the range of 52% to 56% over the next 12 to 18 months.
guidance.quote: So over a period of time, I think our warehousing sales will remain in the range of, let's say, about 52% to 55%, 56%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that Q1 FY27 performance aligned with quarter-on-quarter guidance and exceeded annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: Uniparts India expects its growth in FY27 to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The company expects the first quarter of FY27 to be in line with the fourth quarter of FY26, and the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment momentum from late 2025 has continued into Q1 FY27, driven by infrastructure-led spending.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment conditions remain subdued, with calendar year 2026 representing the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the large agricultural equipment, conditions remain subdued as has been widely acknowledged across the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment in India is performing well, supported by government subsidy programs.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Western market small agricultural equipment growth remains measured due to economic uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: In the Western market, small ag growth remains more measured.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket business was flat year-on-year in absolute terms due to tariff-driven price volatility.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led investments in the US and Europe are supporting strong customer schedules and order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture in India is performing well due to government subsidy programmes and higher adoption in mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Western small agriculture unit volumes are displaying initial recovery signs following three years of volume declines.
demand_outlook.quote: That said, the bottom appears to be behind us; after three consecutive years of volume declines, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes, and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs view CY2026 as the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with meaningful recovery expected during CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket segment is expected to return to growth as tariffs have moderated following price volatility.
demand_outlook.quote: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalise and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: In North America, construction equipment demand is expected to continue growing in FY27, with the second half of the year being stronger than the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market shows early signs of recovery after passing its cyclical low.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is expected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in Europe is showing early signs of stabilization with modest growth expected for FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the outlook for FY27 is positive with modest growth anticipation.

demand_outlook.claim: India's tractor industry demand remains stable, though its future performance depends on the monsoons.
demand_outlook.quote: And coming to India, the tractor industry demand remains stable, although we have to see how it reacts to the monsoons.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's ongoing capex requirements are roughly 2.5% to 3.5% of total revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: I think overall, if you see, even after having done that, today, our capex requirements as a business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of our total revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule without interrupting supply to customers.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations in Mexico are on track, with initial deliveries from the warehouse targeted for Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts India plans to keep its capex at 2.5% to 3.5% of its revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's capex for the fourth quarter of FY26 stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR 90 crores, representing a 55% growth year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials for the quarter was about 33.3%, largely due to a product mix change.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a cycle EBITDA margin target of about 20% peak to trough.
margins_costs.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q1 FY27 was 66.6% compared to 65.6% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (As % of Revenue from Ops) 66.6% 64.7% 65.6%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 expanded to 25.3% from 20.7% in Q1 FY26.
Uniparts India achieved an EBITDA margin of 24% for Q4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects to operate comfortably above its sustainable 20% EBITDA margin level as volumes build in FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

margins_costs.claim: A new wage code introduced in November 2025 had a INR 3.4 crores impact on the company's profitability.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

margins_costs.claim: Freight and raw material costs are directly passed through to customers.
margins_costs.quote: And I think as far as we are concerned, the freight and the raw material component of the cost is a direct pass-through to customers, right?

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Construction equipment currently accounts for 45% of the company's total revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the third quarter of FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the quarter 3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a net cash position of approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended quarter with net cash position of approximately INR190 crores, underlining the strength of our cash generation capabilities and financial discipline.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of June 30.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is actively evaluating acquisition opportunities to accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has evaluated about a dozen targets since its IPO across hydraulic fabrication and PTO.
capital_allocation.quote: The truth of the matter is that we have evaluated about a dozen targets since IPO across hydraulic fabrication and PTO.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts reported a net cash balance of INR 190 crore at the end of Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company rebuilt its cash balance back to INR 190 crore within ten months of paying a special dividend of INR 101 crore in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore. In ten months, through focussed operations and business growth, we have rebuilt to that level.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts India is net debt-free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company distributed a total dividend of INR 170 crores for FY26, which included a special dividend of INR 101 crores declared in Q3.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: The special dividend in Q3 FY26 was partly paid out because the company decided not to proceed with an evaluated acquisition opportunity.
capital_allocation.quote: The special dividend that we paid out in Q3 of FY26 is partly because we evaluated an opportunity carefully and then decided not to proceed.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia situation has exerted pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility in the aftermarket business led to some demand skewing.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Large agricultural equipment conditions remain subdued, with a mid-teens decline expected this year.
risks_headwinds.quote: We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Price volatility driven by tariffs skewed aftermarket demand by prompting customers to slow purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred in the finishing shop of the company's Ludhiana facility towards the end of Q3.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Escalations in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical situations have led to rising input prices, though some inflation is mitigated by favorable exchange rates.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, some of this inflation is being mitigated by favourable exchange rates.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: The fabrication vertical is expected to become a meaningful vertical in the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than FY26 growth.
management_commitments.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

management_commitments.claim: Mexico revenue for FY27 is expected to be in the mid-single-digit million dollar level.
management_commitments.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

management_commitments.claim: Warehousing sales are expected to remain in the range of 52% to 56% in the next 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: And I think that's where we foresee this to remain in the next, let's say, 12 to 18 months.

management_commitments.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule.
management_commitments.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts India expects its growth in FY27 to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to operate comfortably above its 20% EBITDA margin level as volumes build through FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

management_commitments.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to keep its capex plans unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of its revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

management_commitments.claim: The company is working to rebuild its facility and have it online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
